property_summary: For any callee address that implements transferFrom(address,address,uint256) and for any non-empty _tos array and value v, C.transfer(...) always succeeds (returns/does not revert) because it calls transferFrom on the callee; the mutant that calls transfer(address,address,uint256) can fail for some callee implementations (e.g., a contract that only implements transferFrom and reverts on transfer), so the mutant will revert for some inputs while the reference never does.
change_summary: Change the calldata selector used in external call from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transfer(address,address,uint256), altering which external function is invoked and thus potentially changing observed effects.
